events.text: Lisa Fruichantie comes on board as Inchunwa Project Director.
Second [live recording at IndigiPopX](/episodes/ep-21-indigipopx) at the First Americans Museum in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.

[Our first retreat is held in Broken Bow, Oklahoma](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Ei1xT8xMZiaJ7NztDxhKOkrEFVkeJYs9?usp=sharing), to receive feedback from people in our communities on the direction of the project and movement. This is the first time many people received their markings at once.

[Inchunwa, along with Chickasaw Nation citizens, hosts a Chickasaw Community Conversation around Tattoo Revitalization](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DRWvdiAzPCZJidu3g-0-yTE7DyNAu_KS?usp=sharing). Out of this, Icho’wa was formed.
Lisa presents about Inchunwa at iWow in North Carolina.
[Instagram Live recording](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DCu-TfTyXJG/) at the Indigenous Tattoo and Music Festival in Albuquerque, New Mexico.
[Article published about Inchunwa in the Choctaw Nation’s Tribal newspaper, the Biskinik](https://biskinik.com/news/the-inchunwa-project-a-journey-to-reviving-southeastern-tribal-tattoos/).
